title: A rigorous failure of one proof mechanism at the admitted boundary
statement: For the admitted exceptional P0, every polynomial closed two-form correction to the ordinary compatible heat density fails pointwise PSD. Symmetry and null-column identities force j>=-3/4 and j<=-19/24. Higher polynomial-degree leading corrections have zero density because they vanish on spanning plane-wave Hessians, so no higher degree escapes. This is not a no-QC theorem, and angular/nonpolynomial corrections or other compatible evolutions remain available.
